description:
Quickly Prep Deliveries and Letters with a Set of Custom Sheet Labels

Print a set of sheet labels you can apply on packages, envelopes, products, and other branded items. Basic shaped (rectangular) labels are printed on 8.5” x 11” sheets. For custom shapes, you can choose from four sheet sizes. Perfect for small businesses that prepare their own orders and promotions. Find out how easy it will be to choose, design, and print your full sheet labels.

 

How to Make Sheet Labels for Your Business 

 

Choose the sheet size based on the number of labels you need. 

Do you need a lot of mailing labels or just a few for asset management? Our sheet labels give you the flexibility of printing what you need, when you need it. You can print up to 30 pieces of 2.685” x 1” labels on each 8.5” x 11” sheet. If you need only two pieces of 2” x 2” labels, you can opt for a smaller sheet size such as 4” x 6”.  

 

Print with materials that elevate the look of your artwork. Our labels are printed in either indoor-friendly white paper sticker or white paper and white BOPP sticker for outdoor use.  

  • White paper sticker is ideal for general indoor use. It is made of smooth, semi-gloss, pressure-sensitive adhesive paper. This material sticks to most surfaces and is best used for decorative purposes. 
  • White paper is our most popular label material. It comes with a matte, gloss, and uncoated finish. The label’s surface is writable with a permanent ink marker, making it perfect for personalized handwritten labels. 
  • White BOPP  is the most durable label material we offer. It  is resistant to tearing moisture, and UV exposure. White BOPP labels come with a gloss and matte  finish. 

 

Upload a design, create one online, or download a template from the designated tab. 

Have a print-ready design? Upload the design and we’ll review it for technical errors. Make sure the image resolution is at least 300 dpi and set in CMYK color mode. 

If you’re still creating a design, download any of the formats on the Templates tab. All files include the necessary print guidelines for accurate results. 

You can also select “Create Your Design Online” and you’ll be taken to the intuitive tool on your browser. The menu allows you to add images, combine colors, and edit text.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Up to how many label can I fit on a sheet?

The number of labels you can print on a sheet depends on the size of both the label and the sheet. For basic rectangular shapes, you can print up to thirty labels 2.685” x 1” in size on a single 8.5” x 11” sheet. When designing custom shapes, just keep in mind that the labels need to be at least 1” x 1” in size and have a 0.25” from each other. Refer to the table below which illustrates how many custom-shaped labels can be printed on two common sheet sizes. 

4" x 6" Sheet Size

Sticker Size Stickers on a Sheet
1" x 1" 8 stickers
2" x 2" 2 stickers
3" x 3" 1 sticker

 

8.5" x 11" Sheet Size

Sticker Size Stickers on a Sheet
1" x 1" 48 stickers
2" x 2" 12 stickers
3" x 3" 6 stickers
4" x 4" 2 stickers
Q: What paper size do you use for sheet labels?

For labels printed in basic shapes, we use an 8.5” x 11” sheet. For custom shaped labels, you can choose from  four different sizes: 4" x 6", 8.5" x 11", 5.5" x 8.5", and 3.5" x 8". You can also order a custom size as long as the dimensions fit inside an 8.5” x 11” sheet. 

Q: Are your sheet labels waterproof?

The 4 mil white vinyl material we use for our labels is waterproof.

Q: Can I write on the uncoated white paper sticker?

Yes, the uncoated option allows you to write on the white paper sticker material with a pen or marker. Perfect for writing down the customer’s mailing details on personalized address labels. 

Q: Do you offer free shipping when I order in bulk?

No, but you can estimate the shipping price after selecting “Estimate Shipping & Delivery” and inputting your ZIP code. A price for 1-day transit will appear. Free pick up is available for customers based in Los Angeles. ?
